home.seoTitle: Luxury Chauffeur & Limousine Service in Dubai
home.seoDescription: Private chauffeur and limousine service in Dubai: airport transfers, hourly hire, corporate travel and weddings, with fixed prices and professional chauffeurs.

hero.title: Arrive Beyond Expectation
hero.lead: A discreet, impeccably presented chauffeur service for airport transfers, business travel and the occasions that matter.

experience.title: Every journey, quietly perfected.
experience.body: From the moment you are met to the moment you arrive, each detail is considered: a chauffeur who knows the city, a car prepared for you, and a price agreed before you travel.
experience.imageAlt: The rear cabin of a luxury sedan, with two reclining seats in quilted leather

meet.title: Meet and greet
meet.body: Met by name in the arrivals hall and escorted to your car.

water.title: Chilled water
water.body: Complimentary bottled water on every journey.

seats.title: Child seats
seats.body: Fitted before you are collected, on request.

cta.title: Your car is waiting.
cta.body: Reserve online in minutes, or speak to us on WhatsApp at any hour.

fleet.seoDescription: Explore our Dubai chauffeur fleet: executive and first class sedans, luxury SUVs, VIP vans and stretch limousines, each with a professional chauffeur.
fleet.title: A car for every arrival.
fleet.lead: Five classes of vehicle, each presented immaculately and driven by a professional chauffeur. Choose the one that suits the journey.
fleet.note: Vehicles are booked by class. The exact model depends on availability on the day.

services.seoDescription: Limousine service in Dubai for every occasion: airport transfers, hourly chauffeur hire, corporate travel, weddings, city tours and intercity journeys.
services.title: Chauffeur services in Dubai and beyond.
services.lead: From the arrivals hall to the wedding aisle, each service rests on the same promise: a professional chauffeur, an immaculate car and a price agreed in advance.

about.seoDescription: A Dubai chauffeur service built on punctuality, discretion and presentation, for travellers, executives, families and hotels.
about.title: A quieter way to travel.
about.lead: We are a Dubai chauffeur service built on a simple idea: the journey should be the calmest part of your day.

story.title: Effortless, by design.
story.first: Dubai moves quickly. Our work is to make moving through it feel effortless: a car that arrives early, a chauffeur who has already planned the route, and a cabin that lets you rest, think or work.
story.second: We serve travellers, executives, families and hotels to the same standard, whether the journey is ten minutes from the airport or a day across the Emirates.

punctuality.title: Punctuality
punctuality.body: We plan around traffic and flight times, so that your car is waiting for you and not the other way round.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.body: What is said in the car stays in the car. Your privacy is part of the service.

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.body: Immaculate vehicles and chauffeurs in business attire, on every journey.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: Licensed chauffeurs, well-maintained vehicles and careful driving, always.

contact.seoDescription: Contact our Dubai reservations team by phone, WhatsApp or email, at any hour.
contact.title: Speak to us at any hour.
contact.lead: For reservations, changes and questions, reach us in whichever way is easiest. WhatsApp is usually the quickest.
contact.mapTitle: Map showing the location of our office

faq.seoDescription: Answers to common questions about booking a chauffeur in Dubai: airport pickups, prices, payment, child seats and the areas we cover.
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.lead: The essentials on booking, airports, prices and the service. If your question is not here, ask us directly.
